Present dito sina TV5 Network, Inc. Chairman Manny V. Pangilinan at SMC Chairman Ramon Ang.

Workers collect trash from the Estero de Sunog Apog near the pumping station in Tondo, Manila on Wednesday, November 12, during the launch of Oplan Kontra Baha of the Department of Social Welfare and Development.

The program seeks to mitigate flooding in urban communities by clearing waterways and promoting proper waste management. 

📷: John Louie Abrina | MB
